SIGNALS.name: Amir Husain
SIGNALS.summary: Amir Husain says DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (552B) runs locally at 18.7 tokens/s on a roughly $2,600 desktop built from a 12 GB RTX 3060, a Quadro M4000 and 544 GB of DDR4.

SIGNALS.name: Developing Adventures
SIGNALS.summary: A developer account says Claude Code 2.1.325 contains four hidden switches, including a weekly limit-reset command and a brief-updates mode. Unconfirmed by Anthropic.

SIGNALS.name: International Energy Agency
SIGNALS.summary: The IEA says data centre investment is surging as AI becomes central to economic policy, and points to concerns about the impact on electricity systems and energy affordability.

SIGNALS.name: Sam Boboev
SIGNALS.summary: Reports that OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet, adding Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Stripe and Adyen to its agentic commerce setup for ChatGPT's weekly users.

SIGNALS.name: FT India News
SIGNALS.summary: FT India News links a Financial Times report that India is pinning hopes on an AI start-up to avoid becoming a 'digital colony'.

SIGNALS.name: Sundar Pichai
SIGNALS.summary: Sundar Pichai recaps Google's week: new 8th-gen TPUs, Gemini 4 Carbon, Gemini Robotics 2.5, AlphaGenome 2, the Gemini Decisions API and Gemini 4 Hydrogen.

SIGNALS.name: Gagan Ghotra
SIGNALS.summary: An SEO analyst reports large swings in Google AI Overviews since the November 2026 Core Update began rolling out, based on 10K keywords across 20 niches in US desktop results.

SIGNALS.name: Google
SIGNALS.summary: Google says Search is getting its biggest model update yet with Gemini 4 Hydrogen, rolling out globally, with better understanding of nuanced multi-part questions.

SIGNALS.name: Google AI
SIGNALS.summary: Google AI introduces Gemini 4 Hydrogen, positioned beside Carbon as a faster, efficient model for everyday coding and agentic workflows.
